item.title: Nazi-Looted Painting in Real Estate Listing Must Be Returned
item.description: The 18th-century painting “Portrait of a Lady” was stolen by a high-ranking Nazi in the 1940s. Last year, it surfaced in a real estate listing in Argentina.

item.title: In Peru, the Trump Administration Sees the Limits of Its Anti-China Push
